title: BanG Dream! It's MyGo!!!!! // Ave Mujica Anime's 2nd Teaser Unveils January 8 Debut
content: The second promotional video for the BanG Dream! It's MyGo!!!!! // Ave Mujica sequel television anime series debuted on Sunday, and it announces that the anime will premiere on January 8, 2027. The series will air in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels in Japan.

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 50 (Finale) Preview, Staff, and Synopsis Revealed
